Inflow Rate -> Net Flow Rate.full: Lavoisier, A. (1789). Traité Élémentaire de Chimie. Conservation of mass: mass in = mass out + accumulation.
Sterman, J.D. (2000). Business Dynamics. McGraw-Hill. Chapter 6: Stock-flow structure.

Outflow Rate -> Net Flow Rate.full: Conservation of mass principle: Net accumulation = Inflow - Outflow.

Net Flow Rate -> Water Level.full: Sterman, J.D. (2000). Business Dynamics. McGraw-Hill. Stocks integrate their net inflows.
Forrester, J.W. (1961). Industrial Dynamics. MIT Press. Stock-flow relationships.

Water Level -> Outlet Pressure.full: Pascal, B. (1663). Traité de l'équilibre des liqueurs. Hydrostatic pressure: P = ρgh.
White, F.M. (2016). Fluid Mechanics. 8th Edition. McGraw-Hill. Chapter 2: Pressure Distribution.

Outlet Pressure -> Outflow Rate.full: Torricelli, E. (1643). De Motu Gravium. Torricelli's theorem: v = √(2gh), flow velocity from pressure.
Bernoulli, D. (1738). Hydrodynamica. Bernoulli's principle relating pressure to flow velocity.

Outlet Valve Opening -> Outflow Rate.full: White, F.M. (2016). Fluid Mechanics. 8th Edition. McGraw-Hill. Chapter 6: Viscous Flow - valve flow coefficient.
